name: Non-Monotonic Energy Matrix Reduction
description: Replaces the local inequality constraint (s_u != s_v) with a global per-node energy sum requirement. The energy cost between adjacent nodes is -1 for different assignments and +2 for identical assignments, with a target sum of -d_i. This perfectly preserves the 3-coloring logic but destroys simple backtracking: because costs are negative, partial sums are non-monotonic, preventing naive pruning. Models must either mathematically prove the equivalence to 3-coloring or write a custom branch-and-bound heuristic; otherwise they will TLE or WA.
